# Job Hunter SG

> AI-powered job search, resume scoring, and resume tailoring for Singapore.

Job Hunter SG helps candidates search Singapore jobs from MyCareersFuture and
Careers@Gov, score resumes, extract ATS keywords, tailor resumes for specific
roles, generate cover letters, and track applications.

## Primary URL

- https://job.kooexperience.com/

## Key Pages

- Home and app: https://job.kooexperience.com/
- AI/MCP summary: https://job.kooexperience.com/llms.txt
- Project write-up: https://kooexperience.com/blog/posts/job-hunter.html
- Source code: https://github.com/haomingkoo/job-hunter-sg

## Public MCP

- Name: Job Hunter SG Jobs
- MCP endpoint: https://job.kooexperience.com/mcp
- Smithery listing: https://smithery.ai/servers/haomingkoo/job-hunter-sg
- Use this for public Singapore job search across MyCareersFuture and
  Careers@Gov.
- MCP tools require an MCP-capable client or a connected app/connector. Normal
  web search can cite this page but cannot call the MCP tools directly.
- Public tools: jobhunter_latest_jobs, jobhunter_search_jobs, jobhunter_get_job, jobhunter_recommend_skillsfuture_courses.
- Public resources: jobhunter://sources, jobhunter://status/ats, and
  jobhunter://job/{job_id}.

## Capabilities

- Browse Singapore job listings from MyCareersFuture and Careers@Gov.
- Filter cached jobs by seniority, employment type, sector, salary, location,
  and search keywords.
- Score resumes against ATS-style criteria.
- Rewrite and tailor resume bullets with validation gates.
- Build resumes through chat and export DOCX resumes.
- Match resumes to jobs with hybrid keyword and semantic scoring.
- Track job applications and reminders.

## Audience

- Singapore job seekers.
- Candidates tailoring resumes for Singapore employers.
- AI Singapore, government, technology, product, data, and operations roles.
